label: final copy step (outputting last original token), esp. L=3 with input b/m/3/h
explanation: Very sparse, weak unit (max activation 0.016). Fires only in the copy phase, never in the original or delimiter phases; 91% of activation mass is on the final copy step (to_go==0, outputting the last original token, input = second-to-last original token), with the rest on the one or two steps before it. Within the last step it prefers L=3 (48% of mass, step 5) and L=9 (33%, step 17), and inputs h, m, b, 3 (lift 4-9x). The top activations are of this kind (e.g. c b v <DEL> c [b]). The last-copy-step location alone gets mass recall 0.91 but precision 0.003, because the unit fires on only a small, unpredictable subset of those steps. The recorded predicate (L=3, last step, input in {b,m,3,h}) reaches dev F1 0.31 and covers only 37% of mass. Never fires when in_tok is making its first appearance (in_first=1).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=12: h, m; t=13: h, x, 3, a; t=11: h, x, m, 0) and the first original token (most: c, d, b, t, q, s; least: h, i, n, g); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, L=3, to_go=0.
